description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: Used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests. It can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and must not include non-ASCII characters.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~610399~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 用于设置切换的最大容忍时间，超过容忍时间后将取消切换，单位为秒，可选值范围为10～3600。
description.en: The timeout period for the switchover operation. The operation is canceled after it has been performed for a time period that exceeds the value. Unit: seconds. Valid value: 10 to 3600.

description.zh:
用于指定切换的操作类型：
* switch：切换。
* cancel：取消。
* interrupt：中断。
description.en:
The type of the switchover operation. Valid values:

*   switch
*   cancel
*   interrupt

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds switch-over-major-version-upgrade --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pgm-m5e4gegx63fh92bn --type switch --switchover-timeout 10 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
